title: Annika Sorenstam sends prayers to Vanessa Trump as tributes pour in after cancer diagnosis - NewsBreak
text:
By Joseph McBride ,
59 minutes ago
Golfing legend Annika Sorenstam has offered prayers for Vanessa Trump following her Instagram announcement revealing a breast cancer diagnosis. Trump, the ex-wife of Donald Trump Jr. - who is currently in a relationship with golf superstar Tiger Woods - disclosed that she has already had surgery and is developing a treatment plan with doctors.
Numerous celebrities and politically connected individuals posted supportive messages following Trump's announcement, including Sorenstam. The Hall of Fame golfer, who has visited the White House and been awarded the Presidential Medal of Freedom by President Donald Trump , conveyed her support through an emoji on Instagram.
Sorenstam left a praying emoji on Trump's post as a gesture of solidarity. Haley Cavinder, an American influencer and former Miami basketball player, also responded: "Praying for you," accompanied by a red heart emoji. Ivanka Trump, Vanessa's former sister-in-law, added her voice: "Praying for your continued strength and a swift recovery. Love you mama." It comes as Scottie Scheffler reevaluates priorities in life after the birth of his second child .
In her public statement, Trump shared, "I've recently been diagnosed with breast cancer. While this isn't news anyone expects, I'm working closely with my medical team on a treatment plan.
"I would like to thank my doctors for performing a procedure earlier this week on me. I am staying focused and hopeful while surrounded by the love and support of my family, my kids, and those closest to me.
Vanessa Trump announced on Wednesday she had been diagnosed with breast cancer "Thank you for your kindness and support it truly means more than I can express. I kindly ask for privacy as I focus on my health and recovery. Vanessa."
It has been a turbulent time for Trump, as Woods was arrested in March after rolling his car and was held on suspicion of DUI. He subsequently entered a treatment facility in Zurich, Switzerland, before returning to Florida last week.
Woods was present at Kai Trump's high school graduation ceremony at the Benjamin School, showing his support for Vanessa and her daughter. Woods's children are also enrolled at the private institution, which is where he first met Trump, and the couple publicly announced their relationship in 2024.
According to People , Woods approached his recent Switzerland trip with dedication. A source revealed to the publication, "Tiger took his trip seriously and is all about continuing his recovery and putting this chapter behind him. He is in good spirits and also can't wait to put the legal issues to rest."
Vanessa Trump is dating Tiger Woods The source further indicated that despite Trump's disappointment with the circumstances, their relationship remains strong and the separation hasn't affected their bond. "Vanessa and Tiger are in love, still serious, and happy to see each other," the source stated.
It was additionally reported that Trump is "eager to help him continue with his progress and move beyond any more public scandals - which they both dislike intensely."
